notes.subject: ol king
notes.rationale: Direct address: God's rebuke to kings, quoted speech with imperatives.

notes.subject: במשיחי
notes.rationale: 'Mine anointed ones' — here the patriarchs, not king/priest; rendered literally 'man bilong mi we ol i kapsaitim oil long ol' per the glossary rule for משיח.

notes.subject: imperatives
notes.rationale: Twin prohibitions 'no ken… no ken' summon the addressee; the deprecative אל is kept as 'no ken'.

translation: No ken tekim han long ol man bilong mi we ol i kapsaitim oil long ol, na no ken mekim nogut long ol profet bilong mi.

tokens.gloss: ol man bilong mi we ol i kapsaitim oil long ol
na long ol profet bilong mi
